arguments.content:
I need to determine the year the tallest lattice tower was completed.

The tallest lattice tower in the world is the **Tokyo Tower** in Japan, standing at 333 meters (1,091 feet). It was completed in **1958**.

While there are taller guyed masts, Tokyo Tower holds the record as the tallest self-supporting steel lattice tower.
